name: DataList
summary: The one way to show rows of records: Cynco UI's tray table on wide containers, one stacked card per row on narrow ones.
use: Any list of documents, accounts, transactions or lines. Don't hand-build <table> markup in a screen; declare columns and let DataList handle layout, selection, totals and the narrow-width card view.
provide: columns (key, header, cell, align, className, mobile: title | value | badge | meta | hidden | table | stacked, stackedAs, stackedCell, stackedLabel), rows, getKey; optional stackBelow (sm…3xl or never, default xl = 36rem of container width), column nowrap (keep IDs and dates on one line in the table), onRowClick (rows become keyboard-focusable; Enter/Space activates), isRowSelected, rowClassName, leading / leadingHeader (checkbox), trailing (row menu), totals ({label, [columnKey]: node} — a column-aligned tfoot in the table, a bold summary card when stacked), footer, empty, caption, dense / density (compact | default | comfortable; defaults from DensityProvider), stickyHeader + maxHeight (rows scroll, headers and totals stay put), className and any div props.
notes: Responds to its own container (CSS container queries), so the same list works in a page, a side sheet and on a phone. Leading/trailing cells stop click propagation so a checkbox or menu doesn't open the row.

name: StatTile
summary: One KPI (label, value, optional unit, sub line, badge and status dot) and StatGrid, the auto-fitting grid that holds them.
use: Rows of headline figures above a list or report. Put tiles in a StatGrid so they go 4-up on a page, 2-up in a sheet and 1-up on a phone.
provide: StatTile: label, value, optional unit, sub, badge, tone (green | blue | red | orange | amber | yellow | purple | pink | fuchsia | neutral), dot (any CSS colour; prefer tone), negative, className, div props, children (e.g. a sparkline). StatGrid: min (sm 9rem | md 11rem | lg 14rem tile width), mode (fit — default, tiles stretch to fill the row; fill — keep empty tracks to align with other grids), className, div props.
notes: The value wraps only between words (after "RM"), never mid-number, and never truncates; it steps up a size once the tile is 13rem wide.

name: SectionPanel
summary: A titled card whose header actions wrap under the title when the container is narrow.
use: Grouping a chart, a detail list or a small table under a heading with actions. Use flush for content that runs edge to edge (tables).
provide: title, description, actions, flush, className, children and any section props.
notes: Named SectionPanel so it never collides with the AI kit's flow-canvas Panel.

name: KeyValueList
summary: A label/value list: side by side when there's room, label above value below 16rem.
use: Totals blocks, document detail rails, payment summaries.
provide: items ({label, value, negative, strong}), className.
notes: Values are tabular-nums and right-aligned; negative uses text-error-text, strong makes a total row.

name: ActionBar
summary: ActionBar is a row of controls that wraps instead of overflowing; ScrollRow is a single row that scrolls sideways (tabs, steppers, chips).
use: ActionBar for page and card toolbars. ScrollRow when the items must stay on one line in order, like status tabs or a stepper.
provide: className, children and any div props (both).
notes: ScrollRow hides its scrollbar; give it a role (tablist, list) and labels when it carries navigation.

name: ToneDot
summary: A 6px dot (or square) in one of Cynco UI's status tones; toneBg exposes the same background classes for bars and legend keys.
use: A small colour cue next to text that already says the state (account type, autosave, aging bucket).
provide: tone, square, className and any span props (title for a hover hint).
notes: Decorative (aria-hidden): the meaning must also be in nearby text.

name: Button
summary: Cynco's one button: six variants on Base UI's Button, 28px tall by default.
use: Use `primary` for the single main action of a view or sheet, `secondary` for everything else, `muted` and `skeleton` for quiet toolbar actions, `destructive` only for irreversible deletes, `dotted` for "add another" slots.
provide: Children (label, optional Phosphor icon at 14px). Optional `isLoading` (shows `SmallSpinner`, keeps width), `disabled`, `size` (`default` 28px · `sm`/`mini`/`icon` 24px), `render`/`asChild` to render as a link.
notes: Primary = `primary` fill with `primary-foreground` text, a 135° sheen and `shadow-sm`; secondary = `interactive-secondary` with `input` border and `btn-secondary-shadow`. Radius `rounded-lg` (= `radius`). One primary per surface.

name: ButtonGroup
summary: Joins adjacent buttons, inputs or selects into one segmented control.
use: Segmented choices that act as one unit (date ranges, split buttons).
provide: Buttons/inputs as children; `orientation` horizontal (default) or vertical. `ButtonGroupText` and `ButtonGroupSeparator` for labels and dividers.
notes: Inner radii and duplicate borders are removed automatically.

name: IconButton
summary: A Button with a leading or trailing icon slot, sized for Cynco's 14px Phosphor icons.
use: Any action whose icon helps scanning: "New invoice", "Filter". Icon-only for compact toolbars (pair with a tooltip).
provide: All Button props plus `icon`, `rightIcon` and `iconOrientation` (`left` · `center` · `right`).
notes: Use `skeleton` for icon-only actions inside rows.

name: IconTooltipButton
summary: An icon-only button that always carries a tooltip label.
use: Compact toolbars and row actions where the icon alone is not self-explanatory.
provide: `tooltip` text, `icon`, `onClick`, optional `disabled`.
notes: Every icon-only action should use this (or IconButton + Tooltip) so it has an accessible label.

name: ShortcutButton
summary: A primary or secondary Button that shows and binds a keyboard shortcut.
use: Sheet and dialog submit actions (`metaShortcut="enter"` → ⌘/Ctrl ↵) and page-level "new" actions (`singleShortcut="n"`).
provide: `children`, `metaShortcut` or `singleShortcut`, `variant` (`primary` · `secondary`), `onClick`, `isLoading`.
notes: The shortcut is registered while mounted; the keycap renders inside the button.

name: ToolbarButton
summary: The 20px vertical-ellipsis button that opens a table row's actions menu.
use: Last cell of a table row, as the trigger of a DropdownMenu.
provide: Button props (usually via `DropdownMenuTrigger render`). Clicks stop propagation so the row click does not fire.
notes: Always `skeleton`, icon-only; give it an `aria-label`.

name: CopyButton
summary: Copy-to-clipboard buttons for IDs and keys, with a "Copied!" tooltip.
use: `CopyButton` for an ID shown as a chip, `CopyIconButton` for an icon-only copy next to text, `MiniCopyButton` for inline mono IDs in tables (icon reveals on hover).
provide: `text` to copy; `displayText` (Mini) to shorten what is shown; `side` for the tooltip.
notes: IDs render in the mono family.

name: CopyTextButton
summary: A bordered mono chip that copies its text, with a copy icon.
use: Showing a document number or ID the user is expected to copy.
provide: `text`, optional `children` (display), `copySize`, `icon`.

name: InlineAction
summary: A text-link-style action with an optional small icon.
use: "Add line", "Edit" links inside forms and sheets where a full button is too heavy.
provide: Button attributes plus `icon`; children is the label.
notes: Text in `tertiary-foreground`, `primary` on hover.

name: PanelButton
summary: A large, tactile tile button with screws and seams, selected state glowing in the primary colour.
use: Picking one of a few big options in onboarding (business type, tax registration).
provide: `isSelected`, `onClick`, `icon` (Phosphor duotone, 20px).
notes: Selected tile uses the `panel-shadow` glow (primary-tinted); unselected tiles are neutral. Styled for the light theme.

name: GroupedTabButton
summary: A segmented tab control: equal-width options in a single pill track.
use: Switching a small set of mutually exclusive modes (period, chart range).
provide: `value`, `onValueChange`, `options` [{value, label?, icon?, disabled?}].
notes: Fills its container width; constrain the parent.

name: Input
summary: The single-line text input: 28px, `interactive-secondary` fill, `input` border.
use: Every text field. Use `variant="destructive"` for validation errors, `headless` inside composite fields.
provide: Native input props, `variant`.
notes: Built on the form layers: `input-base` + `input-shadow-default` + `input-state-focus` (see Forms). Focus darkens the border and adds a soft 3px ring, never a coloured outline.

name: InputGroup
summary: An input with addons — icons, text, buttons — inside one bordered field.
use: Search fields, inputs with units or prefixes, inline submit buttons.
provide: `InputGroupAddon` (`align` inline-start · inline-end · block-start · block-end) holding `InputGroupText` or `InputGroupButton`, plus `InputGroupInput` or `InputGroupTextarea`.
notes: Uses `input-state-focus-within`.

name: InputOTP
summary: One-time-code input built on input-otp: grouped slots with an optional separator.
use: Sign-in OTP entry.
provide: `maxLength`, `value`, `onChange`; children `InputOTPGroup` of `InputOTPSlot index`, `InputOTPSeparator`.

name: Textarea
summary: Multi-line text input with the input styling.
use: Descriptions and notes.
provide: Native textarea props.

name: LongInput
summary: A monospace-friendly textarea on `input-background` for JSON and long values.
use: Metadata editors and pasted config.
provide: Native textarea props.

name: LabelInput
summary: A labelled Input with an optional description line above it.
use: Most form fields in sheets: name, IDs, URLs.
provide: `label`, `placeholder` (required), optional `description`, input props.
notes: Label uses `text-form-label`; description `text-body-secondary`.

name: TagInput
summary: A free-text input that turns entries into removable tags.
use: Lists of IDs or emails typed by the user.
provide: `value` string[], `onChange`, optional controlled `inputValue`.
notes: Enter or comma adds a tag; Backspace on empty removes the last.

name: TagSelect
summary: A multi-select shown as tags inside a select-style trigger.
use: Choosing several known options (tags, branches, tax codes).
provide: `value`, `onChange`, `options` [{value,label}], `placeholder`, optional `formatTag`, `renderContent`.

name: DateInputUnix
summary: A date (and optional time) picker whose value is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
use: Due dates, schedule dates, backdating.
provide: `unixDate` (ms or null), `setUnixDate`; optional `withTime`, `use24Hour`, `disablePastDates`, `minUnixDate`/`maxUnixDate`, `placeholder`.
notes: Opens a Calendar in a Popover.

name: TimePickerInput
summary: A two-digit time segment input (hours, minutes, 12-hour) with arrow-key stepping.
use: Composing a time picker; used inside DateInputUnix.
provide: `picker`, `date`, `setDate`, optional `period`, focus hand-off callbacks.
notes: Adapted from openstatusHQ/time-picker (MIT).

name: Calendar
summary: Month calendar on react-day-picker 8, selected day filled with `primary`.
use: Inside date popovers; inline when a date is the main input.
provide: react-day-picker props: `mode`, `selected`, `onSelect`, `defaultMonth`, `disabled`.
notes: Outside days shown by default.

name: Select
summary: Base UI select with a 28px trigger and an `overlay` popup with check indicators.
use: Choosing one of a short, known list (payment terms, currencies). Use SearchableSelect past ~8 options.
provide: `value`/`defaultValue`, `onValueChange`, `items` (labels for the value display); children `SelectTrigger` › `SelectValue`, `SelectContent` › `SelectItem`.
notes: Trigger uses `input-state-open`. `SelectItem indicator={false}` drops the checkmark.

name: SearchableSelect
summary: A generic select with a search box, built on Popover + Command.
use: Choosing an account, item or customer from a long or remote list.
provide: `value`, `onValueChange`, `options`, `getOptionValue`, `getOptionLabel`; optional `renderOption`, `renderValue`, `onSearchChange` (server search), `header`/`footer`, `trigger`.
notes: `emptyText={null}` hides the empty state.

name: Checkbox
summary: Square checkbox in three sizes, `primary` when checked.
use: Boolean options in lists and tables; use Switch for settings that apply immediately.
provide: `checked`/`defaultChecked`, `onCheckedChange`, `size` (`sm` · `md` · `lg`), `disabled`.

name: TextCheckbox
summary: A Checkbox with a clickable text label.
use: Single options in forms.
provide: Checkbox props and the label as children.
notes: Label uses `text-checkbox-label`; disabled uses `text-checkbox-disabled`.

name: AreaCheckbox
summary: A checkbox with a title and description, optionally revealing children when checked.
use: Opt-in settings that need explanation (rounding, auto-numbering).
provide: `title`, `checked`, `onCheckedChange`; optional `description`, `disabled` + `disabledReason` (tooltip), `children` (shown when checked).

name: IconCheckbox
summary: A toggle that looks like a small secondary button with an icon; checked shows the `primary` border.
use: Toggling views and options in toolbars and attach/cancel forms.
provide: Button props plus `checked`, `onCheckedChange`, `icon`, `iconOrientation` (`left` with a label, `center` icon-only).
notes: Default size `sm`.

name: RadioGroup
summary: Base UI radio group; items are small circles filled with `primary`.
use: Choosing one of 2–5 visible options.
provide: `value`/`defaultValue`, `onValueChange`; `RadioGroupItem value` children, each wrapped in a label.
notes: For options with descriptions use AreaRadioGroupItem.

name: AreaRadioGroupItem
summary: A radio option with a label and description line.
use: Tax treatment and behaviour choices in sheets.
provide: Inside RadioGroup: `value`, `label`, optional `description`, `disabled` + `disabledReason`.

name: Switch
summary: On/off switch, 36×20 (or 28×16 inside `SwitchSizeProvider size="sm"`).
use: Settings that take effect immediately.
provide: `checked`/`defaultChecked`, `onCheckedChange`, `disabled`.
notes: Thumb uses `switch-thumb-on` when on.

name: Dialog
summary: Centered modal on `overlay-dialog` with `overlay-dialog-shadow`.
use: Confirmations and short, blocking decisions. Longer forms go in a Sheet.
provide: `open`/`onOpenChange`; `DialogContent` (`showCloseButton`), `DialogHeader` › `DialogTitle` + `DialogDescription`, `DialogFooter` with secondary then primary/destructive buttons.

name: Sheet
summary: A side panel for create/edit flows, sliding in from any edge.
use: Most create and edit forms in Cynco (new customer, new item).
provide: `open`/`onOpenChange`; `SheetContent side`, `SheetHeader` › `SheetTitle` + `SheetDescription`, body, `SheetFooter`.
notes: Submit with a ShortcutButton (`metaShortcut="enter"`).

name: Popover
summary: A floating panel on `overlay` anchored to a trigger.
use: Inline details, small forms and pickers.
provide: `PopoverTrigger` (use `render` to supply your Button), `PopoverContent` with `align`, `side`, `sideOffset`.

name: Tooltip
summary: Short label shown on hover/focus; delay 0 by default.
use: Naming icon-only controls and clarifying terms.
provide: `TooltipTrigger` (with `render`) and `TooltipContent` (`side`, `align`). `Tooltip` brings its own provider.
notes: Keep it to one line.

name: HoverCard
summary: A richer hover preview (Base UI PreviewCard).
use: Previewing a customer or invoice from a link.
provide: `HoverCardTrigger`, `HoverCardContent` with `align`/`side`.

name: DropdownMenu
summary: Base UI menu: items with icons, shortcuts, checkbox/radio items, submenus and a destructive variant.
use: Row actions and overflow menus.
provide: `DropdownMenuTrigger` (with `render`), `DropdownMenuContent`, `DropdownMenuItem` (`variant`, `shortcut`, `isLoading`), `DropdownMenuGroup` › `DropdownMenuLabel`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`, `DropdownMenuSub`.
notes: A `DropdownMenuLabel` must sit inside a `DropdownMenuGroup`. Destructive items go last, after a separator.

name: Command
summary: cmdk command palette: search input, grouped items, shortcuts, footer hints.
use: The ⌘K palette (`CommandDialog`, sizes `default` · `compact`) and searchable lists inside popovers.
provide: `CommandInput`, `CommandList` › `CommandEmpty`, `CommandGroup heading`, `CommandItem`, `CommandShortcut`, `CommandSeparator`, `CommandFooter`/`CommandHint`/`CommandKbd`.

name: InfoTooltip
summary: A small info icon that shows an explanatory tooltip.
use: Next to labels whose meaning is not obvious.
provide: Tooltip content as children; optional `side`, `align`.

name: ConditionalTooltip
summary: Wraps an element in a tooltip only when `enabled`.
use: Explaining why a control is disabled.
provide: `enabled`, `content`, one element child.

name: SheetCloseButton
summary: The ✕ button positioned in a sheet's top-right corner.
use: Custom inline sheets that do not use SheetContent's built-in close.
provide: `onClose`.
notes: Positions itself absolutely; the parent must be `relative`.

name: SheetBackdrop
summary: Full-viewport dimming backdrop for inline sheets, portaled to the body.
use: Behind floating inline sheet panels.
provide: `isOpen`, `onClose`, optional `zIndex`.
notes: Click closes.

name: Tabs
summary: Base UI tabs with `default` (pill) and `underline` list variants.
use: Switching sections of a page (`underline`) or modes inside a panel (`default`).
provide: `Tabs value/defaultValue`, `TabsList variant`, `TabsTrigger value variant`, `TabsContent value`.
notes: Pass the same `variant` to the list and its triggers.

name: Breadcrumb
summary: Breadcrumb trail with chevron separators.
use: Detail pages (Customers › Acme › Invoices).
provide: `BreadcrumbList` › `BreadcrumbItem` › `BreadcrumbLink` / `BreadcrumbPage`, `BreadcrumbSeparator`, `BreadcrumbEllipsis`.
notes: Links in `muted-foreground`, current page in `foreground`.

name: Pagination
summary: Minimal pagination containers (nav › list › item).
use: Wrapping your own previous/next Buttons. Tables use the DataTable pagination parts.
provide: Children; `PaginationContent`, `PaginationItem`.

name: Accordion
summary: Base UI accordion with a chevron that rotates open.
use: FAQs and stacked optional sections.
provide: `defaultValue`/`value` (array), `type="multiple"`; `AccordionItem value` › `AccordionTrigger` + `AccordionContent`.

name: SheetAccordion
summary: Accordion sections styled for sheets: title, description, optional separators.
use: Grouping long create/edit sheets into collapsible sections.
provide: `type`, `defaultValue`, `withSeparator`; `SheetAccordionItem value title description`.

name: Collapsible
summary: Show/hide a region with a trigger.
use: "Advanced settings" and similar disclosures.
provide: `open`/`defaultOpen`, `CollapsibleTrigger` (with `render`), `CollapsibleContent`.

name: Carousel
summary: Embla carousel with previous/next buttons.
use: Document template and onboarding galleries.
provide: `Carousel opts orientation setApi` › `CarouselContent` › `CarouselItem`, `CarouselPrevious`, `CarouselNext`.
notes: Leave horizontal room for the arrow buttons.

name: Badge
summary: A small rounded label in three variants.
use: Counts and neutral labels. Use StatusChip for states.
provide: `variant` (`default` · `muted` · `secondary`), `size` (`default` · `sm`), children.
notes: Prefer `muted`; `default` is the zinc pill.

name: BetaBadge
summary: A tiny "BETA" tag.
use: Next to the title of a feature in beta.
provide: Optional `className`.

name: IconBadge
summary: A badge with a leading or trailing icon.
use: Metadata like currency, branch, external links.
provide: `icon`/`rightIcon`, `variant` (`default` · `muted`), `position`.

name: StatusChip
summary: A neutral chip whose only colour is a small status square with a glyph.
use: Invoice, payment and filing states in tables and headers.
provide: `tone` (green · blue · red · orange · amber · yellow · purple · pink · fuchsia · neutral), `glyph` (check, clock, alert, x, pause, play, calendar, coins, …), `dashed` for drafts, label as children. `StatusChipIcon` is the square alone; `StatusRing` is a progress ring (`fraction` 0–1).
notes: Never colour the label — the square carries the state, and every state has a glyph and a word, so it never relies on hue. Tone hexes are fixed in the component (e.g. green #30a46c, blue #3e8bd9, red #e5484d, amber #e5a21f), not tokens.

name: StepBadge
summary: A small numbered square for step lists.
use: Onboarding steps.
provide: The step number as children.

name: SectionTag
summary: A muted uppercase-free tag that labels a section.
use: Section headings inside sheets and editors.
provide: Children.

name: FilterChip
summary: An active filter shown as `label value ×`.
use: Inside search bars and toolbars to show applied filters.
provide: `label`, `value`, `onRemove`.

name: InfoRow
summary: A label/value row with an optional icon.
use: Detail panels (customer, invoice).
provide: `label`, `value`, optional `icon`, `mono` for IDs.

name: Card
summary: A `card` surface with header, title, description, action, content and footer slots.
use: Grouping related content on a page.
provide: `CardHeader` › `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardAction`; `CardContent`; `CardFooter`.
notes: Radius `rounded-xl`, 1px `border`, `shadow-sm`.

name: Alert
summary: Inline notice in five tones: default, note, success, warning, destructive.
use: Page- or section-level messages that stay visible.
provide: `variant`; an optional leading 16px icon, `AlertTitle`, `AlertDescription`, `AlertAction`.
notes: Tinted at 4% fill and 15% border; text stays `foreground` at 80%. Tone hues come from Tailwind (sky, emerald, amber, red), not tokens.

name: Table
summary: Plain table primitives (table, header, row, head, cell, footer, caption).
use: Small static tables. For data lists use DataTable.
provide: Native table element props; `flexibleTableColumns` on `Table`.

name: DataTable
summary: Cynco's data-table kit on TanStack Table: toolbar, heading, tray, header, body, virtualisation, pagination and column visibility.
use: Every list page (invoices, customers, items).
provide: A TanStack `table` instance (`useReactTable` + `getCoreRowModel` from `@tanstack/react-table`) passed via `DataTable.Provider config={{table, numberOfColumns, isLoading}}`; compose `Toolbar` › `Heading` + `Actions`, then `Container` › `Content` › `Header` + `Body`. Optional `onRowClick`, `getRowHref` + `linkComponent`, `enableSelection`, `virtualization`.
notes: Exported as `DataTable` so it does not clash with the `Table` primitive. Surfaces use the `table-*` tokens.

name: ChartContainer
summary: shadcn chart wrapper for Recharts: maps a config to `--color-<key>` variables and supplies tooltip and legend content.
use: Revenue, expense and cash charts.
provide: `config` {key: {label, color | theme}} and one Recharts chart as child (import it from `recharts`); `ChartTooltip` + `ChartTooltipContent`, `ChartLegend` + `ChartLegendContent`.
notes: Colour series with `chart-series-1…8` in order; grid lines `chart-grid-stroke`.

name: Progress
summary: A thin progress bar, `primary` on a muted track.
use: Progress against a target, setup progress, import progress.
provide: `value` 0–100; optional `ProgressLabel`, `ProgressValue` children.

name: Skeleton
summary: A pulsing `muted` placeholder block.
use: Loading states shaped like the content.
provide: Sizing classes.

name: SmallSpinner
summary: A small circular spinner.
use: Inline loading (buttons use it automatically when `isLoading`).
provide: `size` in px.

name: LoadingShimmerText
summary: A line of text with a moving shimmer and spinner.
use: Long-running background work ("Syncing bank feed…").
provide: `text`.
notes: Uses the `.shimmer` gradient from the stylesheet.

name: CopyablePre
summary: A code block (or inline span) with a copy button.
use: Install commands and API keys in onboarding.
provide: `text`; `CopyableSpan` for inline.

name: Label
summary: A plain form label.
use: Labelling custom controls.
provide: Children.

name: FormLabel
summary: The standard field label in `text-form-label`, dimmed when disabled.
use: Above inputs in sheets.
provide: Children, `disabled`.

name: FieldLabel
summary: A field label with optional description and info tooltip.
use: Fields that need a hint.
provide: Children, optional `description`, `tooltip`, `empty`.

name: PageHeader
summary: Page title row: icon + title (+ accessory) on the left, actions on the right.
use: Top of every list page; matches DataTable.Toolbar.
provide: `icon` (16px Phosphor fill in `subtle`), `title`, optional `titleAccessory`, actions as children.

name: PageContainer
summary: The main content panel that sits on `outer-background`.
use: Wrapping each page's content.
provide: Children.

name: SandboxBanner
summary: The blue tab hanging from the top edge that marks sandbox mode.
use: Shown on every page while working in a sandbox or demo company.
provide: Optional `label`, `icon`, `color`; `SandboxBannerAction` children.
notes: Fill is `sandbox`; text white.

name: Separator
summary: A 1px horizontal or vertical rule in `border`.
use: Dividing groups in toolbars and panels.
provide: `orientation`.

name: ScrollArea
summary: A scroll container with thin custom scrollbars.
use: Lists inside fixed-height panels and popovers.
provide: Children; sizing classes; `ScrollBar orientation` for horizontal.

name: ResizablePanelGroup
summary: Resizable split panes (react-resizable-panels 4).
use: Editor layouts with a sidebar and canvas.
provide: `orientation`, `ResizablePanel defaultSize`, `ResizableHandle withHandle`.

name: AmountInput
summary: The money field accountants type into: accepts plain figures, “1,234.50”, accounting brackets “(500)”, “1.2k” and formulas like “=1200*1.08” or “100+250.50-20”, and commits an exact decimal string.
use: Anywhere a user enters an amount. While focused it shows exactly what was typed (with a live “= RM 1,296.00” hint for formulas); on blur or Enter it evaluates and shows the formatted, right-aligned figure.
provide: value / defaultValue (decimal string, "" for empty), onValueChange(value: string), currency? (adds the symbol prefix via InputGroup and formats the hint), allowNegative?, invalid? + errorMessage?, placeholder?, messages? ("below" for forms, "overlay" for grids), onAutoFill? (what “=” then Enter fills), onParseError?, inputClassName?, className (root) and any native input props (aria-*, name, disabled, onBlur…). Forwards its ref to the <input>.
notes: Maths via parseAmount / toSen (BigInt, half-up), so 0.1 + 0.2 is 0.30. Fills its container's width; negatives display bracketed in text-error-text.

name: JournalGrid
summary: A keyboard-first journal line editor: searchable Account, Description, Debit and Credit cells with spreadsheet movement, auto-balance and a sticky footer showing Total Dr, Total Cr and whether the entry balances.
use: On the journal entry create/edit screen, and anywhere else lines must balance (opening balances, accrual templates, payroll postings).
provide: lines / defaultLines ({ id, accountId?, description?, debit?, credit? } with decimal-string amounts), onLinesChange(lines), accounts ({ id, code, name, type }), currency? (default MYR), minLines? (default 2), showShortcuts? (default true), className and native div props. Helper: journalTotals(lines) → { debit, credit, difference }.
notes: Keys: Tab / Shift+Tab move across cells and wrap to the next/previous line (and leave the grid past the ends); Enter moves down and adds a line on the last one; Shift+Enter up; ↑ ↓ change line in the same column unless the account list is open; mod+Enter adds a line below; mod+Backspace deletes the line (clears it at the minimum); Alt+B, or “=” then Enter in an amount cell, fills the figure that balances the entry; a Debit clears that line's Credit and vice versa, and a negative figure flips sides. Account cell: type a code or name, ↑ ↓ and Enter/Tab to pick, Alt+↓/F4 opens, Esc closes. Totals via sumAmounts; StatusChip shows Balanced / Out by RM x. Responsive: a grid on containers ≥ 36rem, a card per line below that (Debit and Credit side by side, each ≥ 6rem); the footer is sticky to the nearest scroll container.

name: InlineEditCell
summary: A table cell that edits in place: click, Enter or F2 to edit text or an amount, Enter or Tab to save, Esc to cancel, with a spinner while an async save is pending and a revert plus message when it fails.
use: Inside DataList / table cells for quick single-field corrections where opening a form would be slower: descriptions, references, amounts on draft documents.
provide: value, onSave(value) => void | Promise<void> (reject with an Error to revert and show its message), kind? ("text" | "amount"), currency? (amount read-out), placeholder?, allowNegative?, disabled?, aria-label (field name, e.g. "Description for EXP-2026-0311"), className and native div props.
notes: Keyboard: the cell is a button (visible focus ring, pencil on hover/focus); Enter, Space, F2 or click starts editing; Enter saves and returns focus to the cell; Tab or blur saves and moves on; Esc cancels. Amount mode uses AmountInput, so formulas work and an invalid figure stays in edit mode. Status (Saving… / Saved / error) is announced through aria-live; the saved tick fades after 1.6s. Fills its cell, so it follows DataList's table / stacked layouts.

name: CommandPalette
summary: A ⌘K / Ctrl+K command palette on Cynco UI's CommandDialog: jump to any area, create documents, reopen recent records and run app actions, with fuzzy search across labels, keywords, document numbers and amounts.
use: Mount once in the app shell and put a CommandPaletteTrigger in the header. Feed it recently opened records so accountants can type “inv 0142” or an amount like “3240” and land on the document. Use `inline` to embed the same search on a page (an empty state, a “Jump to” screen).
provide: CommandPalette: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange; items (CommandPaletteItem[]: id, group — “Go to” | “Create” | “Recent” | “Actions” or your own heading, label, keywords, icon, shortcut such as "mod+k" or "g i", hint, href, disabled, onSelect; defaults to CYNCO_PALETTE_ITEMS, Cynco's registry paths, keywords and keybinds); recent (CommandPaletteRecord[]: id, type — invoice | quotation | bill | credit_note | customer | vendor | journal | payment | item | account, number, label, status, amount as a decimal string, currency, keywords, href, onSelect); recentLimit (default 5); onSelect(item) to route with item.href / item.id; hotkey (default "mod+k", false to bind your own); placeholder; inline; className. CommandPaletteTrigger: label, shortcut, className and any button props (wire onClick).
notes: Keys: ⌘K / Ctrl+K toggles, ↑ ↓ move, Enter runs, Esc closes (clears the query when inline), a leading “>” narrows to actions. Search: every word must match a label, keyword, number or amount (prefix > word start > fuzzy subsequence; acronyms like “gl”, “pl”); groups re-rank by best match. Focus returns to whatever opened it. Rows drop status, amount, type and keycaps as the dialog narrows (container queries), so it stays one line from 320px up.

name: ShortcutsDialog
summary: A searchable dialog listing every keyboard shortcut in sections, opened with “?”, plus useGoToShortcuts for two-key “g then i” navigation.
use: Mount once in the app shell. Pass your own sections or use CYNCO_SHORTCUT_SECTIONS (Global, Go to, Create, Lists, Journal entry). Call useGoToShortcuts(CYNCO_GOTO_ROUTES, navigate) in the shell so G then I opens Invoices and C then J starts a journal entry.
provide: ShortcutsDialog: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange; sections ([{title, items: [{keys, label}]}], keys like "mod+enter", "g i" for a sequence, or an array of alternatives); hotkey (default "?", false to bind your own); title; className. useGoToShortcuts(map, navigate, {enabled, timeout = 1200 ms, leader = "g"}): map keys are a letter after the leader or a full sequence ("c i"); returns {pending} so you can show “G…” while it waits.
notes: Keys: “?” opens (never while typing), type to filter by label, key or section, Esc closes and returns focus. Sequences are ignored while typing, inside dialogs and menus, and with ⌘/Ctrl/Alt held; any other key or the timeout cancels. Sections flow into two columns once the dialog is 36rem wide.

name: SavedViewsBar
summary: Saved views for any list: a scrolling row of view tabs with counts, the active filters as removable FilterChips, and Save / Save as new / Reset once the filters drift from the view; rename, duplicate, share and delete from the active view's menu.
use: Above a DataList whose rows you filter from `filters`. Ship built-in views (All, Overdue, Due this week) as `locked`, let people save their own as personal or shared with the team, and persist `views` through onViewsChange.
provide: views / defaultViews / onViewsChange (SavedView: id, name, filters, count, shared, locked); activeViewId / defaultActiveViewId / onActiveViewChange; filters / defaultFilters / onFiltersChange (SavedViewFilter: id, field, label, value — the list applies field+value, chips show label and value); counts (rows per view id); addFilter (your Add-filter control, rendered after the chips); label (accessible name, default “Saved views”); className and any div props.
notes: A blue dot marks a modified view; locked views offer Save as new only. The tab row scrolls sideways on narrow containers and the save actions wrap under the chips.

name: BulkActionBar
summary: Floating toolbar for ticked rows: "3 selected · RM 34,890.00", Select all N / Clear, the main actions as buttons and the rest in a ⋯ menu.
use: Under any DataList with checkboxes. Render it after the list inside the scrolling container; it sticks to the bottom while rows scroll and disappears at 0 selected. Compute `total` with sumAmounts over the selected rows' money field.
provide: count, onClear, actions ([{id, label, icon?, onSelect, destructive?, shortcut? ("p", "shift+v", "mod+e"), disabled?, overflow? (always in the ⋯ menu)}]); optional total (decimal string), currency (default MYR), totalCount + onSelectAll (shows "Select all N"), maxVisible (buttons before the ⋯ menu, default 3), sticky (default true), label (toolbar name), className and any div props.
notes: The count/total is aria-live. Responsive: one row from 48rem of container width (keycaps shown), below that the summary + Select all/Clear sit above the actions, and under 24rem the summary takes its own line; hidden in print.

name: UndoToast
summary: "Do it, then offer Undo": a toast with the message, an Undo button (⌘/Ctrl+Z), a countdown bar and late commit — the real write runs in onCommit only if nobody undoes.
use: Mount UndoToastProvider once near the app root. On a destructive action, update the UI optimistically and call useUndoToast().show({message, onUndo, onCommit}); do the server call in onCommit. Keep real confirm dialogs only for actions that can't be held back (e.g. submitting to LHDN).
provide: UndoToastProvider: children, max (default 3; a 4th toast commits the oldest), duration (ms, default 6000), viewport (default true; false to place <UndoToastViewport/> yourself), position (bottom-center | bottom-right | bottom-left). useUndoToast() → {show({message, onUndo, onCommit?, duration?, undoLabel?, id?}) → id, undo(id?), dismiss(id), count}. UndoToastViewport: position, className, section props. UndoToast (the presentational item): message, onUndo, onDismiss, onExpire, duration, undoLabel, showShortcut, paused, className, li props.
notes: Keyboard: ⌘/Ctrl+Z undoes the newest toast (left alone while typing in a field, where it is the field's own undo); F8 jumps to the newest Undo button; Esc on a focused toast dismisses (commits) it; focus returns to where it was. The countdown pauses on hover, on focus and while the tab is hidden; the stack is an aria-live="polite" list. Each toast settles exactly once; anything pending commits when the provider unmounts or on pagehide. No toast library — the countdown is a CSS animation whose end commits. Width is min(24rem, viewport − 2rem); hidden in print.

name: DensityToggle
summary: Compact / Default / Comfortable row density as a small segmented radio group with line-spacing icons; its value drives DensityProvider.
use: In a list toolbar. Wrap the lists it controls in <DensityProvider density={value}>; every DataList inside picks it up. Pass storageKey to remember the choice per user.
provide: value / defaultValue ("compact" | "default" | "comfortable", default "default") / onValueChange, labels (auto — hide words when the nearest @container is under 22rem; always; never), storageKey (localStorage, uncontrolled use), label (group name, default "Row density"), className and any div props.
notes: The demo DataList uses stickyHeader + maxHeight="16rem" so the header and the totals row stay in view while lines scroll; hidden in print.

name: PrintButton
summary: A "Print" button with a printer icon and a ⌘/Ctrl+P keycap; calls window.print() unless onPrint is given.
use: Next to any Cynco document (TaxInvoiceDocument, ReceiptDocument, ProfitAndLossReport…). Pass onPrint to route printing elsewhere (e.g. download the server-rendered PDF).
provide: onPrint?, bindShortcut? (default: true only when onPrint is set — otherwise the browser's own ⌘/Ctrl+P already prints the print layout), showShortcut (default true), children (label, default "Print"), plus Button props (variant — default secondary, size, disabled, className…).
notes: Keyboard: Tab + Enter/Space; ⌘/Ctrl+P when bound (works from inputs too, as a mod shortcut). Hidden in print.

name: DocumentStudio
summary: The brand editor for every printed document: logo, layout, typeface, language and footer note, with a live preview of any document at any paper size and stamp.
use: Settings → Documents (invoice templates). One brand drives invoices, receipts, statements, payslips and reports, so customers set it once.
provide: brand / defaultBrand / onBrandChange (DocBrand), documents ([{id, label, render({stamp, size}), sizes?, stamps?}]), defaultDocumentId, onPrint. brandFromCyncoTemplate(template, company) maps Cynco's stored invoice template onto a DocBrand.
notes: Controls stack above the preview below 48rem of container width. Logo upload reads the file to a data URL (production should upload it and store the URL). Layout thumbnails and Inter / Geist / Newsreader; documents stay black ink, so there is no colour picker. Print prints only the previewed document.

name: DocumentPage
summary: The document kit: a sheet of paper plus the parts every business document is assembled from — Letterhead, DocumentMeta, PartyGrid, DocumentTable, TotalsBlock, PaymentBlock, EInvoiceBlock, NotesBlock, SignatureBlock, DocumentFooter, DocFields, DocCallout, DocFigureStrip, DocAmountWords.
use: Build any printed document by composing the parts inside a DocumentPage, under a DocumentBrandProvider. Invoices, receipts, statements, payslips and reports in this group are all thin assemblies of these parts.
provide: DocumentBrandProvider brand (company {name, registrationNo, tin, sstNo, address, phone, email, website}, logo (URL or element; typographic monogram when omitted), layout minimal (default) | classic | modern, font inter | geist | serif, locale en | ms | en-ms, labels overrides, signature, footerNote). DocumentPage: size a4 | a4-landscape | a5 | letter | receipt, stamp paid | void | draft | copy | overdue, fit, isolate, brand (override). Figures are decimal strings, printed as given.
notes: Black ink on white paper only — no colour, tints or filled bars; hierarchy from type, spacing and hairlines. In print: real paper size and margins, page numbers "2 / 3", headers repeat, rows never split, and only the document prints (isolate). On screen the sheet scales to its container. amountInWords writes Ringgit Malaysia in English or Malay; formatDocAmount and formatDocDate are exact and timezone-safe.

name: TaxInvoiceDocument
summary: Malaysian tax invoice — or plain Invoice for a seller not registered for SST — assembled from the document kit.
use: Printing / PDF-ing a posted sales invoice, including foreign-currency invoices that must show tax and total in MYR for LHDN.
provide: invoice: TaxInvoiceData { title ('taxInvoice'|'invoice'), number, status, subtitle?, invoiceDate, dueDate?, terms?, reference?, currency?, billTo, shipTo?, lines: SalesDocLine[] (description, detail, code, quantity, unit, unitPrice, discount, taxCode, taxRate, amount), totals: TotalsRow[], amountInWords?, exchange? {rate, rateDate, source, taxMyr, totalMyr}, payment? {bank…, qr}, einvoice? {status, uuid, validatedAt, url, qr}, notes?, termsAndConditions?, signature? } + brand?, size ('a4'|'letter'), stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Layouts minimal / classic / modern in black ink only, any font, locales en / ms / en-ms (bilingual labels stacked or slashed). Money is printed exactly as given (decimal strings); nothing is recomputed. Print: named @page with page numbers, table headers repeat, rows and the totals/sign-off blocks avoid splitting; isolate (default true) prints only the sheet. Stamp from status (paid/void/overdue/draft; override with stamp, null hides). Discount and tax columns appear only when a line uses them; tax shows rate with the SST code under it. Totals rows may use label keys subtotal, discount, serviceTax, salesTax, sst, rounding, total, totalDue, deposit, amountPaid, balanceDue. Foreign currency: the exchange rate and MYR equivalents are printed in a ForeignCurrencyNote under the totals. Production must pass the posted totals, the MyInvois QR element once validated, and the DuitNow QR element if used. The computer-generated notice is hidden when a signature is printed.

name: QuotationDocument
summary: Quotation with grouped line sections and subtotals, optional add-on items, totals, terms & conditions and a customer acceptance block beside the issuer's signature.
use: Sending a priced proposal for the customer to sign and return (projects in phases, supply + installation jobs).
provide: quotation: QuotationData { number, status, date, validUntil, reference?, terms?, currency?, preparedBy?, customer, shipTo?, lines? | sections? [{title, lines, subtotal}], optionalItems?, totals, amountInWords?, notes?, termsAndConditions (string | string[]), acceptance? (false | {statement, name, date}), signature? } + presentation props.
notes: Layouts minimal / classic / modern in black ink only, any font, locales en / ms / en-ms (bilingual labels stacked or slashed). Money is printed exactly as given (decimal strings); nothing is recomputed. Print: named @page with page numbers, table headers repeat, rows and the totals/sign-off blocks avoid splitting; isolate (default true) prints only the sheet. Section subtotals print as given; optional items are listed in their own group marked 'Not included in the total'. A list of T&Cs prints numbered in two columns. Both sign-off columns use AcceptanceBlock so their lines align; the customer side has a company-stamp box.

name: AdjustmentNoteDocument
summary: Credit note or debit note (kind) against an original invoice, with reason, lines, totals and the MyInvois e-invoice block.
use: Returns, price adjustments and additional charges after an invoice has been issued; both note types are e-invoices in their own right under MyInvois.
provide: note: AdjustmentNoteData { kind ('credit'|'debit'), number, status, date, currency?, customer, originalInvoice {number, date, amount}, reason {category?, text}, reference?, lines, totals, amountInWords?, exchange?, einvoice?, notes?, signature? } + presentation props.
notes: Layouts minimal / classic / modern in black ink only, any font, locales en / ms / en-ms (bilingual labels stacked or slashed). Money is printed exactly as given (decimal strings); nothing is recomputed. Print: named @page with page numbers, table headers repeat, rows and the totals/sign-off blocks avoid splitting; isolate (default true) prints only the sheet. The original invoice (number, date, amount) sits in the meta band; the reason is a DocCallout beside the customer. Settlement rows (e.g. label 'appliedTo' with the invoice number as hint) follow the total.

name: ReceiptDocument
summary: Official receipt in A4, A5 or 80mm thermal size: received from, payment method, amount received, allocation to invoices, amount in words and received-by signature.
use: Acknowledging a customer payment — cash at the counter (thermal, with 5-sen rounding), or cheque / transfer / DuitNow / card / FPX on A4 or A5.
provide: receipt: ReceiptData { number, status, date, currency?, receivedFrom, payment {method: cash|cheque|bank_transfer|duitnow|card|fpx, chequeNo?, bank?, reference?, card?}, amountReceived, allocations? [{number, date, invoiceAmount?, applied}], totals? (e.g. totalDue, rounding, amountReceived, cashTendered, change), notes?, receivedBy? } + size ('a4'|'a5'|'receipt'), monochrome?, brand?, stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Layouts minimal / classic / modern in black ink only, any font, locales en / ms / en-ms (bilingual labels stacked or slashed). Money is printed exactly as given (decimal strings); nothing is recomputed. Print: named @page with page numbers, table headers repeat, rows and the totals/sign-off blocks avoid splitting; isolate (default true) prints only the sheet. A4/A5: amount-received headline, payment strip, 'the sum of' in words, allocation table, optional totals, received-by signature. 80mm: centred letterhead, single column of label/value rows, dashed separators, compact totals and words, no signature; monochrome by default because thermal printers print one ink. Cash rounding is a totals row passed by the caller (BNM 5-sen rounding).

name: DeliveryOrderDocument
summary: Delivery order without prices: deliver-to and bill-to, delivery date, vehicle and driver, ordered / delivered / back-ordered quantities, packages and weight, and a goods-received block.
use: Sending with the goods for the customer to sign on receipt, including partial deliveries with back-orders.
provide: order: DeliveryOrderData { number, status, date, deliveryDate?, reference? (PO), salesOrder?, invoiceNo?, billTo, shipTo, vehicleNo?, driver?, lines [{code?, description, detail?, unit?, ordered, delivered, backOrdered?}], packages?, weight?, notes?, signature?, received? {name, icNo, date, signatureImage} } + size ('a4'|'a5'|'letter') and presentation props.
notes: Layouts minimal / classic / modern in black ink only, any font, locales en / ms / en-ms (bilingual labels stacked or slashed). Money is printed exactly as given (decimal strings); nothing is recomputed. Print: named @page with page numbers, table headers repeat, rows and the totals/sign-off blocks avoid splitting; isolate (default true) prints only the sheet. Quantities are strings printed as given; the back-ordered column only appears when something is outstanding, with zero shown as a dash. The receiving side uses AcceptanceBlock (signature, name, IC no., date and company-stamp box); fill-in lines print blank until received details are passed.

name: PurchaseOrderDocument
summary: A purchase order to a vendor: letterhead with PO number, PO date / required-by / terms / quotation ref / requester, vendor and deliver-to blocks, priced lines with item code, quantity + unit and SST rate, posted totals in words, delivery instructions, terms and prepared-by / approved-by signatures.
use: Printing, emailing or downloading an approved purchase order; the same component renders the on-screen preview.
provide: order: PurchaseOrderData { number, date, requiredBy?, terms?, quotationRef?, requester? {name, department?}, currency?, revision?, vendor: DocParty, deliverTo: DocParty, lines: {itemCode?, description, detail?, quantity, unit?, unitPrice, taxRate?, taxCode?, amount}[], totals: {subtotal?, discount?, taxes?: {label?, rate?, amount}[], shipping?, rounding?, total}, deliveryInstructions?, termsAndConditions?, notes?, preparedBy?, approvedBy?, acceptedBy? }; plus brand?, size? (a4 | letter), stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Minimal / classic / modern in black ink only, any font, en / ms / en-ms (bilingual), all from the DocumentBrandProvider. Lines and totals are printed exactly as given (posted values; no maths in the component). Delivery instructions, T&C and notes sit beside the totals so a typical order fits one A4 in modern/minimal English; classic + bilingual flows to a second page with headers repeated and signatures kept together. Footer omits the 'no signature required' notice because the PO is signed. Tax labels accept {en, ms}. Pass acceptedBy (or true) for a vendor acknowledgement line.

name: PaymentVoucherDocument
summary: A payment voucher: payment date, method (bank transfer with reference, cheque with number, cash, DuitNow, card) and the account it was paid from, payee with bank details, 'Being payment for' purpose, the bills or expense lines paid with account codes, total paid in words, and a four-step approval chain.
use: Supporting document for every bill payment, expense claim reimbursement or petty-cash payout; filed with the bills for audit.
provide: voucher: PaymentVoucherData { number, date, method: {kind: bank_transfer | cheque | cash | duitnow | card, chequeNo?, bank?, reference?}, paidFrom?: string | {name, accountNumber?}, currency?, payee: DocParty, payeeBank? {bankName?, accountName?, accountNumber?, swiftCode?}, memo?, lines: {reference?, date?, description, detail?, accountCode?, accountName?, amount}[], totals: {subtotal?, taxes?, total, …}, notes?, preparedBy?, checkedBy?, approvedBy?, receivedBy? }; plus brand?, size?, stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Credit notes netted off appear as negative lines in brackets. Cheque payments show the cheque number (emphasised) in place of the transaction ref. Signatures: Prepared by · Checked by · Approved by · Received by, in four columns, never split across pages. Fits one A4 in modern/minimal English; classic bilingual may move the signature row to page 2. Total in words follows the brand language (both lines when bilingual).

name: StatementOfAccountDocument
summary: A customer or vendor statement: statement date, period, account no. and terms; the party with an account summary (opening, invoices & charges, payments & credits, closing balance); every transaction with date, type, number, description, debit, credit and running balance; an aging strip ending in the total due; payment details and a tear-off remittance slip.
use: Month-end customer statements and dunning, or vendor statements for reconciliation (role: 'vendor' drops the remittance slip).
provide: statement: StatementOfAccountData { number?, date, periodFrom, periodTo, accountNo?, terms?, currency?, role? (customer | vendor), party: DocParty, openingBalance, totalDebit?, totalCredit?, closingBalance, transactions: {date, type, number?, description?, debit?, credit?, balance}[], aging: {current, days1to30, days31to60, days61to90, days90plus}, totalDue, payment? {bankName?, accountName?, accountNumber?, reference?, qr?}, notes?, remittance? }; plus brand?, size?, stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Running balances, aging buckets and totals are printed as given (negative balances in brackets, zero buckets as an em dash). Transaction type accepts a label key (invoice, payment, creditNote, debitNote, refund, journal), {en, ms} or text, so types translate. A 'Balance brought forward' row opens the table and a closing-balance row ends it. Multi-page: the table header repeats on every printed page, rows never split; aging, payment details, footer and the remittance slip follow the last row. Remittance slip: dashed cut line with scissors, pay-to, customer / account / statement date / reference, amount due, and a blank for the amount enclosed.

name: PayslipDocument
summary: A Malaysian payslip: employer (EPF / SOCSO / LHDN employer numbers) and employee particulars (staff ID, IC, position, department, EPF, SOCSO and income tax numbers, bank account), pay period and pay date, Earnings and Deductions side by side, gross / total deductions / net pay with net pay in words, employer EPF / SOCSO / EIS / HRD Corp contributions as a quieter strip, year-to-date figures and a confidentiality note.
use: Monthly payslips from a pay run, printed, emailed as PDF or shown in the employee portal; A5 for the half-sheet many SMEs print.
provide: payslip: PayslipData { number?, periodFrom, periodTo, payDate, currency?, employer? {epfNo?, socsoNo?, taxNo?}, employee: {name, staffId?, icNo?, position?, department?, epfNo?, socsoNo?, taxNo?, bankName?, bankAccount?}, earnings, deductions, employerContributions?: {label, detail?, amount}[], grossPay, totalDeductions, netPay, totalEmployerContributions?, ytd?: {label, amount}[], note? }; plus brand?, size? (a4 | a5), stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Line labels take keys that translate (basicSalary, allowance, overtime, commission, bonus, epf → KWSP, socso → PERKESO, eis → SIP, pcb, zakat, advance, hrdf → HRD Corp levy), {en, ms} or text; the optional detail line carries the basis (e.g. '11% of EPF wages RM 4,930.00'). All statutory amounts come from the payroll engine and are printed as given (EPF 11% employee / 13% or 12% employer, SOCSO, EIS 0.2%, PCB, zakat, HRDF). A4: meta strip, employee and employer side by side, then a gross, deductions and net strip. A5: one half-sheet: pay period and date move into the letterhead, employer numbers share the Employee row, basis lines are hidden and net pay is a single total with words beside it. Bilingual stacks line labels (English, Malay beneath); basis lines stay in English.

name: ProfitAndLossReport
summary: Printable Statement of Profit or Loss: revenue, cost of sales, gross profit, grouped operating expenses, operating profit, other income and finance costs, profit before tax, tax and profit for the period, with comparative period, variance and variance %.
use: Monthly management accounts, year-to-date and annual P&L packs, board papers — anywhere the P&L leaves Cynco as paper or PDF.
provide: report: ProfitAndLossData — period {kind, end, start?, months?}, basis?, currency?, filters?, title?, columns [{label, sublabel?}], variance?, codes?, revenue[], totalRevenue, costOfSales[], totalCostOfSales, grossProfit, operatingExpenses [{label, lines[], total, totalLabel?}], totalOperatingExpenses, operatingProfit, otherIncome?, otherExpenses?, profitBeforeTax, tax[], netProfit, preparedBy?, preparedOn?, notes? (lines are {label, code?, note?, values[], variance?, variancePct?}); plus brand?, size?, stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Built from ReportHeader + StatementTable + ReportFooter on the kit's DocumentPage. Minimal / classic / modern in black ink only, any font, EN / BM / EN+BM (row and column labels stacked bilingually). Costs are passed as negative figures and print in brackets; every total and variance is printed as given, never recomputed. Gross/operating/pre-tax/net labels switch to 'loss' when the given figure is negative. A4 by default; the column header repeats on each printed page, totals avoid starting a page.

name: BalanceSheetReport
summary: Printable Statement of Financial Position: non-current and current assets, current and non-current liabilities, equity, the 'Total equity and liabilities' line with an accountant's double rule, and a Balanced / Out-of-balance check.
use: Month-end and year-end balance sheets, with a comparative column (e.g. the last audited year end).
provide: report: BalanceSheetData — period (kind 'asAt'), columns, codes?, nonCurrentAssets[], totalNonCurrentAssets, currentAssets[], totalCurrentAssets, totalAssets, currentLiabilities[], totalCurrentLiabilities, nonCurrentLiabilities[], totalNonCurrentLiabilities, totalLiabilities, equity[], totalEquity, totalEquityAndLiabilities, balanced, difference?, basis?, currency?, filters?, preparedBy?, preparedOn?, notes?; plus brand?, size?, stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Note references print in a Note column when any line carries one. All three layouts and EN / BM / EN+BM; A4; header repeats when printed.

name: TrialBalanceDocument
summary: Printable trial balance: account code, account name, debit and credit grouped by account type, matching totals with a double rule, and a quiet 'Balanced' or red 'Out of balance by RM x' line.
use: Month-end close packs, auditor requests, the TB attached to journals. (Named …Document because TrialBalanceReport is the on-screen report.)
provide: report: TrialBalanceData — period, accounts [{code, name, group?, debit?, credit?}], totalDebit, totalCredit, balanced, difference?, basis?, currency?, filters?, preparedBy?, preparedOn?, notes?; plus brand?, size?, stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Consecutive accounts with the same group print under one heading (group can be a label key like 'assets', 'costOfSales', 'expenses'). Empty Dr/Cr sides stay blank, rows are hairline-ruled for long lists. Balanced state is a data flag, never derived. All layouts and locales; A4, header repeats across pages.

name: GeneralLedgerReport
summary: Printable general ledger: per account a header with code, name and opening balance, dated lines with journal no., description, debit, credit and running balance (Dr/Cr), and a closing-balance row with period totals.
use: Ledger listings for audit, account reviews, bank and receivables reconciliations; runs over many pages.
provide: report: GeneralLedgerData — period, accounts [{code, name, openingBalance, lines [{date, journalNo, description, debit?, credit?, balance}], totalDebit, totalCredit, closingBalance}], balanceStyle? ('drcr' | 'brackets'), basis?, currency?, filters?, preparedBy?, preparedOn?, notes?; plus brand?, size? (default 'a4-landscape'), stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Assembled on the kit's DocumentTable (sections per account, dense) so the column header repeats on every printed page; account headers don't orphan and the closing row doesn't start a page. Balances are debit-positive decimal strings printed with a Dr/Cr suffix (Dt/Kt in BM). Running balances come from the ledger — never recomputed.

name: AgedReceivablesReport
summary: Printable aged receivables by customer: current, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90 and 90+ days with a total column, a totals row with double rule, a % of total row, and a bucket summary with proportional bars.
use: Credit-control meetings, month-end receivables review, bank covenant and auditor packs.
provide: report: AgedReceivablesData — period (kind 'asAt'), customers [{name, detail?, current, days1to30, days31to60, days61to90, over90, total}], totals {…same buckets}, percentages {…same buckets, e.g. '49.2'}, summary?, basis?, currency?, filters?, preparedBy?, preparedOn?, notes?; plus brand?, size?, stamp?, fit?, isolate?, className.
notes: Bucket bars deepen from light to dark grey with age (black ink only). Percentages are supplied by the ledger, not calculated. Customer detail line suits code and terms ('C-0012 · Net 30'). A4 portrait by default (very long names wrap; pass size='a4-landscape' for wide ledgers).

name: CashFlowReport
summary: Printable Statement of Cash Flows (indirect method): profit before tax, adjustments, working-capital changes, cash generated from operations, interest and tax paid, investing and financing activities, net change, opening and closing cash, with a reconciliation check.

provide: `open`/`defaultOpen`; `ChainOfThoughtHeader`, `ChainOfThoughtContent` › `ChainOfThoughtStep` (`label`, `description`, `status` complete · active · pending, `icon`), `ChainOfThoughtSearchResults` › `ChainOfThoughtSearchResult`, `ChainOfThoughtImage caption`.

name: Checkpoint
summary: A divider row marking a restorable point in a conversation.
use: Between messages, to roll back.
provide: `CheckpointIcon`, `CheckpointTrigger` (Button props + `tooltip`).

name: CodeBlock
summary: Syntax-highlighted code (Shiki, one-light / one-dark-pro) with line numbers and a copy button.
use: Code in assistant replies and tool output.
provide: `code`, `language`, `showLineNumbers`; `CodeBlockCopyButton` child.
notes: The bundle carries Shiki grammars for TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript, JSX, JSON, Bash, Python, CSS, HTML, Markdown, YAML, SQL and Go; other languages render as plain text.

name: CompactPromptInput
summary: A one-line prompt field with the submit button inline.
use: Small "ask about this" boxes without attachments.
provide: `value`, `onChange`, `onSubmit`, `placeholder`, `isLoading`.

name: Confirmation
summary: An approval request for a tool call, built on Alert.
use: When the agent needs a yes/no before acting (deleting, posting).
provide: `state` (AI SDK tool state), `approval`; `ConfirmationTitle` › `ConfirmationRequest` / `ConfirmationAccepted` / `ConfirmationRejected`; `ConfirmationActions` › `ConfirmationAction`.
notes: Each child renders only in its matching state.

name: Context
summary: A token-usage meter with a hover card breaking down input, output, reasoning and cache tokens and cost.
use: Showing how much of the model's context window is used.
provide: `usedTokens`, `maxTokens`, `usage`, `modelId`; `ContextTrigger`, `ContextContent` › `ContextContentHeader`, `ContextContentBody` (usage rows), `ContextContentFooter`.
notes: Cost uses tokenlens model prices.

name: Conversation
summary: A scroll container that sticks to the bottom as messages stream in.
use: The chat transcript.
provide: `ConversationContent` with Messages; `ConversationEmptyState` (`title`, `description`, `icon`); `ConversationScrollButton`.

name: Image
summary: Renders an AI SDK generated image from base64.
use: Images returned by an image model.
provide: `base64`, `mediaType`, `uint8Array`, `alt`, `className`.

name: InlineCitation
summary: Inline citation badges with a hover card listing sources (with carousel for several).
use: Citing sources inside assistant text.
provide: `InlineCitationText`, `InlineCitationCard` › `InlineCitationCardTrigger sources`, `InlineCitationCardBody` › `InlineCitationSource` (`title`, `url`, `description`) or the carousel parts, `InlineCitationQuote`.

name: Loader
summary: A small spinning loader glyph.
use: While the assistant is working.
provide: `size`.

name: Message
summary: A chat message: user bubbles on the right, assistant replies as Markdown, with actions, branches and attachments.
use: Every chat turn.
provide: `from` (`user` · `assistant`); `MessageContent` › `MessageResponse` (Streamdown Markdown) ; `MessageActions` › `MessageAction` (`tooltip`, `label`); `MessageBranch*` for alternative replies; `MessageAttachments` › `MessageAttachment`.
notes: Mermaid diagrams inside Markdown are not bundled and render as nothing.

name: ModelSelector
summary: A command-palette dialog for choosing a model, with provider logos.
use: Model pickers in chat inputs.
provide: Dialog props; `ModelSelectorTrigger`, `ModelSelectorContent title` › `ModelSelectorInput`, `ModelSelectorList` › `ModelSelectorGroup heading` › `ModelSelectorItem` › `ModelSelectorLogo provider` + `ModelSelectorName`.
notes: Logos load from models.dev at runtime.

name: OpenIn
summary: A dropdown that opens the current query in ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, T3, Scira or v0.
use: "Open in…" next to docs or prompts.
provide: `query`; `OpenInTrigger`, `OpenInContent` › `OpenInChatGPT`, `OpenInClaude`, `OpenInCursor`, `OpenInT3`, `OpenInScira`, `OpenInv0`.

name: Plan
summary: A collapsible card describing a plan the agent proposes, with a shimmer while streaming.
use: Before running multi-step changes.
provide: `isStreaming`, `defaultOpen`; `PlanHeader` › `PlanTitle`, `PlanDescription` (strings), `PlanAction` › `PlanTrigger`; `PlanContent`; `PlanFooter`.

name: PromptInput
summary: The full chat composer: textarea, attachments, tools, model select, speech and submit with status.
use: The main chat input.
provide: `onSubmit(message)`, `accept`, `multiple`, `maxFiles`; `PromptInputBody` › `PromptInputTextarea`; `PromptInputFooter` › `PromptInputTools` (buttons, `PromptInputActionMenu`, `PromptInputSelect`, `PromptInputSpeechButton`) + `PromptInputSubmit status`; optional `PromptInputProvider` to control it from outside.

name: Queue
summary: A collapsible queue of pending and completed tasks or messages.
use: Showing what the agent will do next.
provide: `QueueSection` › `QueueSectionTrigger` › `QueueSectionLabel count label`, `QueueSectionContent` › `QueueList` › `QueueItem` › `QueueItemIndicator completed`, `QueueItemContent`, `QueueItemDescription`, `QueueItemActions`.

name: Reasoning
summary: The model's reasoning in a collapsible that auto-opens while streaming and reports how long it thought.
use: Reasoning models' thinking text.
provide: `isStreaming`, `duration`, `defaultOpen`; `ReasoningTrigger` (`getThinkingMessage`), `ReasoningContent` (string, Markdown).

name: Shimmer
summary: Text with a moving shimmer.
use: Short "working" labels while streaming.
provide: String children; `duration`, `spread`, `as`.

name: Sources
summary: A "Used N sources" disclosure listing source links.
use: Under answers that searched the web or docs.
provide: `SourcesTrigger count`, `SourcesContent` › `Source href title`.
notes: Collapsible: pass `defaultOpen` to show the list.

name: Suggestion
summary: A horizontal row of suggested prompts as pill buttons.
use: Empty chats and follow-up ideas.
provide: `Suggestions` › `Suggestion suggestion onClick`.

name: Task
summary: A collapsible task with its sub-steps and file references.
use: Showing an agent's search or edit work.
provide: `TaskTrigger title`, `TaskContent` › `TaskItem` (with `TaskItemFile`).

name: Tool
summary: A collapsible card for a tool call: name, status badge, parameters and result as highlighted JSON.
use: Every tool call in a transcript.
provide: `ToolHeader` (`type`, `state`, `title`), `ToolContent` › `ToolInput input`, `ToolOutput output errorText`.
notes: States: input-streaming, input-available, approval-requested, output-available, output-error, output-denied.

name: WebPreview
summary: A mini browser: navigation buttons, URL bar, an iframe body and a collapsible console.
use: Previewing a page the agent built.
provide: `defaultUrl`, `onUrlChange`; `WebPreviewNavigation` › `WebPreviewNavigationButton tooltip`, `WebPreviewUrl`; `WebPreviewBody` (iframe); `WebPreviewConsole logs`.
notes: The demo leaves out the iframe body.
